name: Instance Sync
description: Synchronizes the current event and picked pixel location between exactly two RenderDoc instances - e.g. comparing the same locked-camera scene across two different captures, frame by frame. Enable this extension in both instances; they sync via a named shared-memory mapping, so there is no host/client setup required. Not part of the compiled fork build - see FORK_FEATURES.md for install steps.
author: alandtse/renderdoc fork
